notes: All 5 seeds ran full 30 epochs (early stopping patience=7 not triggered — val_loss kept improving slowly). val_acc values from W&B summary snapshots; best_val_loss from status.json (most reliable). Performance aligns with literature: sequential MNIST LSTM ~99.2-99.5%. LSTM clearly outperforms the SNN baseline (97.62%) and matches the dense CNN (99.17%) at a fraction of the inference cost when applied sequentially.
